about: J-3219 positive control for the D-0608 pre-fire check. 20 questions reconstructed from data/training/curiosity.jsonl rows 2026-10-29..11-01 with random.seed(11); random.sample over the flat question pool (reproduces 8 of the 9 questions F-3504 quotes: Jomini, Directory, Acre, Brune, wounded soldiers, mortification, 'dismantling the self', Bluebird; the 'neglected frontier sea shore' question did not reproduce, so the pool differs slightly from F-3504's). Items 1 and 5 are judgement calls.
